title: Applying a discount makes the total wrong (goes up)
body: Steps: add an item priced $100, apply a 10 percent discount, view the total. The total increases to $110 instead of decreasing to $90. This is wrong and happens every time. Looks like apply_discount adds the discount instead of subtracting it.

title: Discount coupon increases the price instead of reducing it
body: Applying a 10 percent discount coupon at checkout increases the total instead of reducing it. On a $100 cart it charges $110, which is wrong. The discount adds to the total. Consistently reproducible every time.
